Name: Navy Ancient Crops
Author: Ppku123
Description:
Navy Ancient Crops
[b]Expand your farm with six mysterious crops inspired by ancient magic, forgotten nature, and cosmic energy![/b]
Navy Ancient Crops is a Content Patcher mod for Stardew Valley that introduces six unique crops with custom pixel art, growth stages, regrowth cycles, and special gameplay characteristics.
From magical berries to volcanic mushrooms and skeletal ferns, each crop offers a different farming experience.
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]6 unique crops with custom pixel art.[/*]
[*]Custom seed, produce, and growth-stage sprites.[/*]
[*]Regrowable crops with different growth times and harvest yields.[/*]
[*]Rare seeds available from the Dwarf and Mr. Qi.[/*]
[*]Farming and Combat skill-based unlocks.[/*]
[*]A special letter from Pierre containing a free Gale Berry Seed.[/*]
[*]Unique consumable effects for selected crops.[/*]
[*]Content Patcher integration.[/*]
[/list][heading]The Six Crops[/heading]
Ancient Chrono Berry
A mysterious berry infused with the essence of time.
[list]
[*]Growth: 56 days[/*]
[*]Regrowth: Every 7 days[/*]
[*]Harvest: 2–3 berries[/*]
[*]Base selling price: 4,500g each[/*]
[*]Effect: +1 Speed for 120 in-game minutes[/*]
[*]Seasons: All four seasons[/*]
[*]Seed source: Dwarf's Shop[/*]
[/list]Amber Heart
An ancient, glowing root preserved by mysterious forces.
[list]
[*]Growth: 28 days[/*]
[*]Regrowth: Every 5 days[/*]
[*]Harvest: 1 per cycle[/*]
[*]Base selling price: 2,000g[/*]
[*]Effect: +3 Luck for 180 in-game minutes[/*]
[*]Seasons: All four seasons[/*]
[*]Seed source: Dwarf's Shop[/*]
[/list]Pyre Shroom
A volcanic mushroom that radiates intense heat.
[list]
[*]Growth: 21 days[/*]
[*]Regrowth: Every 6 days[/*]
[*]Harvest: 1 per cycle[/*]
[*]Base selling price: 3,200g[/*]
[*]Effect when consumed: -1 Speed for 60 in-game minutes and negative energy restoration[/*]
[*]Seasons: All four seasons[/*]
[*]Seed source: Dwarf's Shop[/*]
[/list]Cosmic Spore
An extraordinary cosmic crop glowing with nebula-like energy.
[list]
[*]Growth: 56 days[/*]
[*]Regrowth: Every 7 days[/*]
[*]Harvest: 1 per cycle[/*]
[*]Base selling price: 50,000g[/*]
[*]Not edible[/*]
[*]Seasons: All four seasons[/*]
[*]Seed source: Qi's Walnut Room[/*]
[*]Seed cost: 1,500 Qi Gems[/*]
[/list]Gale Berry
A magical berry growing on a twisting vine inspired by the wind.
[list]
[*]Growth: 16 days[/*]
[*]Regrowth: Every 6 days[/*]
[*]Harvest: 2–3 berries[/*]
[*]Base selling price: 425g each[/*]
[*]Seasons: Spring, Summer, and Fall[/*]
[*]Unlock: Farming Level 3[/*]
[*]Seed source: Pierre's General Store[/*]
[*]Special unlock: Receive a letter from Pierre with one free seed[/*]
[/list]Bone Fern
A strange skeletal fern resembling the remains of an ancient plant.
[list]
[*]Growth: 17 days[/*]
[*]Regrowth: Every 4 days[/*]
[*]Harvest: 1 per cycle[/*]
[*]Base selling price: 1,200g[/*]
[*]Seasons: Spring, Summer, and Fall[/*]
[*]Unlock: Combat Level 3[/*]
[/list]Craft a Bone Fern Spore using:
[list]
[*]50 Bone Fragments[/*]
[*]10 Mixed Seeds[/*]
[*]100 Fiber[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.1.10 or newer[/*]
[*]Content Patcher 2.6.1 or newer[/*]
[/list][heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Install Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Download Navy Ancient Crops.[/*]
[*]Extract the ZIP archive.[/*]
[*]Place the
[code][CP] NavyAncientcrops[/code]folder inside your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]directory.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][heading]Compatibility[/heading]
This is a Content Patcher content pack designed for Stardew Valley 1.6.
Compatibility with other mods that modify the same game data has not been fully tested.
[heading]Notes[/heading]
Crop values and balance may be adjusted in future updates.
